The back of an east-facing (odd-numbered) house faces west (sunset), and the back of a west-facing (even-numbered) house faces east (sunrise). Therefore, clients with odd-numbered addresses should receive the sunset design. The plan to count even-numbered addresses would yield an incorrect result.
